atomic_statement_summary: The Weil-invariant cuspidal subspace indexed by O equals the corresponding full cuspidal O-piece.
notes: The 'mock Weil' inclusion is proposed as a conjecture (conditional on other conjectures) and is not established in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: In regime J1, as eta tends to zero, the particle process converges in law to an isotropic alpha-stable process.
notes: Extract exactly the J1 subclaim: for each x, X^eta_t(x) converges in law to x plus an isotropic alpha-stable process. The source block also includes J2, which the paper says has already been proved, and the separate J3 case.

atomic_statement_summary: The Paley equiangular tight frame satisfies the restricted isometry property beyond the square-root bottleneck.
notes: Paley ETF satisfying RIP beyond square-root bottleneck is posed as a conjecture linked to Paley constructions; no proof given and remains unresolved.

atomic_statement_summary: For n at least sk, the Erdos matching number e_k(n,s) is the maximum of the two standard extremal constructions.
notes: The Erdős Matching Conjecture is stated and explicitly noted as still open in general; only special cases and ranges are known/proved.

atomic_statement_summary: For every abelian variety A over a number field, the torsion field Q(A_tors) has the Bogomolov property.
notes: S. David's conjecture on torsion fields of abelian varieties having property B is stated and not proved here; it is presented as an open conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: Every n pairwise-intersecting bi-infinite x-monotone k-intersecting curves admit O_k(n) tangencies.
notes: The authors explicitly state they were unable to settle this conjecture and provide partial bounds, so the exact conjecture remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: Every connected graph has equitable chromatic number at most its maximum degree, apart from the stated complete, odd-cycle, and balanced complete-bipartite exceptions.
notes: The Chen–Lih–Wu conjecture is stated as background; the paper only proves partial/large-n results and does not resolve the exact conjecture for all graphs.

atomic_statement_summary: The equilibrium measure of the rotationally symmetric Riesz gas is supported in R^d exactly when a is at least the critical value.
notes: Authors state the support-if-and-only-if claim for all d as a conjecture and explicitly note no rigorous proof in full generality, proving only the special case d=3 in the appendix.

atomic_statement_summary: The stated Lagrangian correspondence quantizes to the BV-BFV bimodule and its induced map equals the Reshetikhin-Turaev map.
notes: Conjecture 1778–1784 (Quantized Lagrangian correspondence) is posed as an unsettled step (Step 4) and is not proved in the paper.
The excerpt is an imperative problem, Show that the stationary Navier-Stokes solution is zero, rather than an author-stated truth-apt proposition.

atomic_statement_summary: The natural SIT-free mosquito equilibrium is globally asymptotically stable relative to the specified positive invariant component.
notes: The global-asymptotic-stability statement is presented as Conjecture~\ref{conj:SIT_free_GAS}; authors report numerical support but do not prove it in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: For a general tensor of the stated format, the span of its singular vector tuples equals the critical hyperplane except in exactly three listed formats, with the stated codimension there.
notes: The paper states this as Conjecture 3 and does not prove it; earlier results relate to it but do not settle the exact classification.

atomic_statement_summary: An mc-edge-critical graph with at least two edges cannot have edges e and f with mc(G-e) less than mc(G) less than mc(G-f).
notes: The conjecture about mc-edge-critical graphs is posed in the paper with supporting evidence (examples), but no general proof is given.

atomic_statement_summary: The cluster-parking statistic satisfies the stated q,t-dihedral sieving identity for every dihedral element and permutation.
notes: The q,t-dihedral sieving identity is presented as Conjecture~\ref{conj2}; partial cases are discussed but the full statement is not proved.

atomic_statement_summary: For arbitrary flexible-GMRES preconditioners, an invertible matrix exists that attains the residual bound sharply at every iteration.
notes: Authors explicitly state this sharpness conjecture for arbitrary matrix preconditioners and leave it open, noting the main technical difficulty.

atomic_statement_summary: A random generic structure obtained from an invariant measure on the stated Fraisse limit is rigid.
notes: The statement is presented in the paper's Conjectures section and is not proved or refuted elsewhere in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: The quantum parameters of convergent positive partial-flag points have the two stated nth-root limits determined by their Schoenberg parameters.
notes: Conjecture~\ref{c:pflag-q-lim} is explicitly posed for finite-index cases; authors prove it in Grassmannian special cases but not in full generality, so the exact statement remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: Infinitely many n satisfy the stated uniform upper bounds for both omega(n-k) and Omega(n-k) over the indicated ranges of k.
notes: The paper notes its theorem falls short (by a log log factor) of Erdős Problem #679 and does not resolve the original conjecture, which remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: Every Master-Hit has a prime divisor of f_1 occurring to exponent one and coprime to every member of its obstruction set.
notes: The paper states the universal exponent-one blocker as a conjecture and explicitly says they do not claim a proof, only computational verification on a finite dataset.

atomic_statement_summary: The Sprague-Grundy values of the staircase positions follow the stated parity pattern.
notes: Authors present SG(s_n) values as a conjecture and do not provide a proof in the paper; it remains posed as an open statement.

atomic_statement_summary: The transform of the semistable structure sheaf is isomorphic to the shriek-pushforward of the structure sheaf in the stated category.
notes: The paper states this as an explicit conjecture (Whittaker normalization) and does not prove it; presented as an open property of the functor Φ.

atomic_statement_summary: Every tree has a near alpha-valuation.
notes: Paper explicitly states this is 'still open' and only computationally verified up to 20 vertices; authors do not prove it here.

atomic_statement_summary: For k=3, generalized cluster monomials in the stated generalized cluster algebra map to classes of simple modules.
notes: Extract exactly the second clause: generalized cluster monomials are mapped to classes of simple modules. The first clause, identifying the Grothendieck ring with the generalized cluster algebra, is proved in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: For every order n, the largest critical set size satisfies lcs(n) at most n^2 minus n^(3/2).
notes: The thesis lists this inequality as an open conjecture; no proof or resolution is provided in the document.

atomic_statement_summary: The Ruzsa number R_m equals 6 for every m at least 40.
notes: Authors present R_m=6 for m≥40 as a conjecture supported by computations up to 100 but do not prove it for all m, so it remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: For each positive delta, the zeros of the Miller-basis element g_{k,m} asymptotically approach the curve C_delta.
notes: Authors pose the asymptotic zeros conjecture and prove only partial results; full statement remains conjectural.

atomic_statement_summary: For some constants C_0 and d below C_0, every sufficiently large logarithmic interval contains an integer with unusually many distinct prime factors.
notes: This is presented by the paper as a conjecture (Conjecture~\ref{conj:weakaveragenumbers}) and is not proved within the work.

atomic_statement_summary: Sums of k dth roots achieve the stated uniform inhomogeneous approximation exponent on the circle.
notes: The uniform-exponent statement is presented explicitly as a conjectural strengthening of the paper's results and is not proved in the text.

atomic_statement_summary: A ladder with diverging circle perimeters has the stated coarse homotopy groups, while bounded perimeters make it coarsely equivalent to a ray.
notes: The ladder coarse homotopy groups formula is stated as a conjecture; authors proved special cases but not the full general statement.

atomic_statement_summary: The consecutive-integer prime-factor bounds are sharp up to constants for both omega and Omega in the stated sense.
notes: This is the authors' conjecture (based on random models) that Theorem 1 is best possible; it is stated but not proved in the paper, so remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: Adjacent triples of partitions related by one pivot have Jack Littlewood-Richardson coefficients congruent modulo the common hook.
notes: Authors explicitly state the divisibility congruence for Jack LR coefficients as a conjecture and give examples but do not prove the general statement.

atomic_statement_summary: The maximum packing quantity M_P(n)(n) is asymptotic to n^3 divided by 6 log n.
notes: Stated as Conjecture 64 in the paper and not proved; authors note only that lower bounds follow from Theorem 11 and Theorem 41, so the exact asymptotic remains open.
The labeled claim depends on undefined qualitative predicates such as shared task representation, semantic alignment, and transfer, so it is not a determinate truth-apt proposition for release.

atomic_statement_summary: For isolated singular central fiber and n greater than one, the analytic-torsion coefficient is independent of H and m and satisfies the stated kernel-dimension formula.
notes: The author introduces this as a conjecture for higher dimensions after proving the n=1/reduced cases; it is proposed but not proved in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: Circuit many-body localization does not exist.
notes: The authors pose 'There is no circuit MBL' as a conjecture and do not prove it; the question of many-body localization in circuits remains debated and unresolved.

atomic_statement_summary: Two tame tangles have the same tangle type exactly when common-dimension mosaics are related by mosaic Reidemeister moves.
notes: The Topological Equivalence Conjecture for Tangles is stated as currently conjectural; authors note injectivity is 'currently conjectural' and do not prove it.

atomic_statement_summary: Sun's two stated congruence classes of integers admit the corresponding representations by two squares and a square of a 2-3 or 2-5 smooth number.
notes: These two conjectures of Sun are quoted by the authors as open conjectures; the paper improves related results but does not prove these statements.

atomic_statement_summary: Equality in the cross-1-intersecting bound for GL_2(q) forces both sets to equal the specified determinant subgroup.
notes: After proving a maximal value theorem, the authors pose the equality/structure case as a conjecture; it is not proved in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: For 4 at most s at most t at most u, the generalized off-diagonal Schur number S(3;s,t,u) equals stu-tu-u-1.
notes: The paper confirms a different Ahmed–Schaal conjecture but explicitly cites S(3;s,t,u)=s t u - t u - u - 1 as a conjecture and only provides bounds/large-u results, not a full proof.

atomic_statement_summary: For odd indices, the cellular-automaton period satisfies P(2i+1)=4^(2i+3)-1.
notes: Period formula P(2i+1)=4^{2i+3}-1 is conjectured based on experiments; the paper presents no proof and later conjectures even-case formula separately.

atomic_statement_summary: The clean lexicographic five-component rank tuple has bounded-delay descent on the stated cubic Weierstrass family for a universal window.
notes: This is an explicit working conjecture introduced in the paper about a specific Weierstrass family; the authors record it experimentally but do not prove it.

atomic_statement_summary: The Gaussian tensor sum satisfies the stated type-2 norm estimate with dimension exponent one-half minus one over p.
notes: Open-problem style conjecture in the survey: a tensor-type inequality for p≥2 is proposed without proof; presented as a conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: For a generic smooth real Weierstrass cubic, the compact oval is nonseparating and its exterior Cauchy transform is not algebraic.
notes: The elliptic (Weierstrass cubic) period cancellation test is stated as a conjecture and left as a concrete open test case; not proved here.

atomic_statement_summary: Adjacent triples of partitions related by one pivot have Jack Littlewood-Richardson coefficients congruent modulo the common hook.
notes: Semantic duplicate of id 2939; id 2939 is kept because it contains the explicit conjecture label and equally complete statement.

atomic_statement_summary: The Almost-Golomb thresholds satisfy j_(k+1)-j_k=G(k), equivalently j_k=S(k-1)+2, for all k at least 4.
notes: The paper explicitly states a conjecture about thresholds j_k and remarks that a complete proof remains open; it performs a conditional reduction but does not resolve it.

atomic_statement_summary: The Links-Gould polynomial completely detects causal linking in the stated spacetimes.
notes: The paper proves LG distinguishes known counterexamples but explicitly conjectures LG completely captures causality; they do not prove this global claim.

atomic_statement_summary: The stated rational system has solutions only at x=(r-1)^2/2, where the solution is unique up to scaling and permutation and is the regular root-of-unity configuration.
notes: The conjecture is verified only for r ≤ 4 (as noted). The paper does not claim a full proof for all r, so the general statement remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: The space Convex(S) is locally compact in the product topology.
notes: Authors pose local compactness of Convex(S) as a conjecture; they prove local compactness only for AConvex(S) and do not resolve Convex(S).

atomic_statement_summary: Every claw-free graph is chromatic-choosable.
notes: Survey states the list-coloring conjecture for claw-free graphs remains largely open, with only partial results and bounds given.

atomic_statement_summary: The operators E_(2,1) and F_(1,2) have the two stated vertex-operator integral representations.
notes: The integral formulas for E_{2,1} and F_{1,2} are explicitly presented as a conjecture in the integral-formula section and not proved in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: Some integer m makes every planar graph (5m-1,m)-choosable.
notes: The conjecture (Zhu 2017) is cited as an open problem; the paper proves related triangle-free results but does not resolve the planar conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: For every weakly chordal graph, the depth of each symbolic power of its cover ideal equals n-1-alpha_t(G).
notes: The equality for weakly chordal graphs is proposed as a conjecture based on computational evidence; the paper proves it for forests but not for all weakly chordal graphs.

atomic_statement_summary: Artin comparison identifies the spans of Hodge classes and Tate classes in every even cohomological degree and power of a smooth projective variety over a number field.
notes: The ℓ-Mumford–Tate conjecture is stated as the wide-open Mumford–Tate conjecture; the paper treats it as background and does not prove it in full.

atomic_statement_summary: The specified primary-branch truncation of a one-node column family cannot decrease the DTWH submatrix norm.
notes: The paper explicitly states Conjecture~\ref{claim:one_node} and uses it as an assumption in Proposition~\ref{prop:strong_dyad} without proving or refuting it.

atomic_statement_summary: For every positive integer k, sigma(n+1)=k sigma(n) has infinitely many solutions.
notes: The statement generalizing Erdos–Sierpiński is presented as a conjecture; the paper proves density zero and conditional infinitude for k=2 only, not the general claim.

atomic_statement_summary: For every infection graph H with at least three edges, the maximum percolation time is bounded by the minimum extremal number of H-e.
notes: The survey explicitly poses this as an open conjecture and does not prove it; no resolution is given in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: Above the critical coupling, every solution of the inertial Winfree model exhibits oscillator death for every initial condition and positive inertia.
notes: Presented in the paper's concluding open problems and not proved or refuted in the text; authors state it would imply a sharper theorem and remains to be proved.

atomic_statement_summary: Over every field of size at least four, each nonsingular matrix maps some all-nonzero vector to another all-nonzero vector.
notes: The Alon–Jaeger–Tarsi conjecture is a long-standing open problem; the paper and prior work give partial results (many fields, large primes) but the full conjecture remains unresolved.

atomic_statement_summary: Every k-quasi-planar topological graph has O_k(n) edges.
notes: The k-quasi-planar linear-edge bound is stated as a longstanding open conjecture; the paper notes it remains open for k≥5 and does not resolve it.

atomic_statement_summary: There do not exist seven mutually unbiased bases in complex dimension six.
notes: The statement 'MUB(6) < 7' is posed as an open conjecture; as of known literature (pre-2024) the full 7 MUBs in dimension 6 is unresolved.

atomic_statement_summary: The maximum number of edges in a C4-free subgraph of Q_8 is 680.
notes: The hypercube conjecture ex(Q8,C4)=680 is explicitly conjectured after presenting a 680-edge construction; the paper does not prove optimality.

atomic_statement_summary: Any finite supported K_r Builder strategy on a triangle-free graph can be amplified to force two compatible supported K_r copies on another triangle-free graph.
notes: The supported-clique amplification lemma is explicitly stated as a conjecture; only r=3 case is established, the general statement remains unproved.

atomic_statement_summary: For every n at least two, the discrete-gradient-matching complexes of the n-simplex and its boundary are homotopy equivalent.
notes: Authors verify the GM-equivalence for n=2,3 but note the general n case remains unresolved and pose it as an open conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: Zhu's two stated local geometric-Langlands identifications hold for every closed point and coefficient ring in the stated setting.
notes: Stated as Zhu's conjecture in the paper and only partially verified in special cases (tori, Λ=L); the general statement is not proved here and remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: Kloosterman sums over any subset of density below one-half satisfy the stated uniform L1 anti-concentration lower bound.
notes: The Kloosterman L^1 anti-concentration statement is presented as an explicit conjectural analytic input; the paper derives conditional geometric results assuming it but does not prove it.

atomic_statement_summary: Every even eigenspace A_p(omega^(2k)) vanishes for each odd prime p.
notes: This is the full Kummer–Vandiver conjecture; the paper proves only a density-one partial/initial-range result, not the full statement, so the exact conjecture remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: A compact Kahler manifold with uniformly RC-quasi-positive tangent bundle, or quasi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature, is projective and rationally connected.
notes: The paper cites Yang's conjecture and makes partial progress (quasi-positive results, uniruledness) but does not prove the full statement; it remains posed as an open conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: The proposed global resolvent trace satisfies the Weil explicit formula over the zeros of the zeta function.
notes: The paper states this resolvent-trace = Weil explicit formula as an explicit conjecture and does not prove it; it is posed as the unresolved existence question whose truth would imply RH in their framework.

atomic_statement_summary: The Macdonald shift map is an isomorphism between the two stated Laurent polynomial lattices.
notes: Conjecture that the shift map restricts to an isomorphism of Laurent lattices is posed explicitly and not proved in the paper (noted as lacking a Knop-Sahi type result).

atomic_statement_summary: Every Lagrangian fibration has the stated multiplicative decomposition, with its tangent-bundle Chern classes lying in the prescribed summands.
notes: Conjecture for Lagrangian fibrations is stated as open; paper records known special cases (projective irreducible symplectic, Hitchin) but does not prove it generally.

atomic_statement_summary: The stated twists of X_(1,0)(N,MN) solve the moduli problem for elliptic curves with prescribed torsion and intrinsic subgroup over every field.
notes: Authors state methods are insufficient to show the moduli claim over general fields and pose the statement as a conjecture; it is not proved in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: The proposed AMP iterates converge to the stated fixed-point state evolution and vector equilibrium with the asserted limiting distribution.
notes: The AMP convergence to equilibrium is stated as a conjecture in the paper; no proof is provided and subsequent text treats it as conjectural.

atomic_statement_summary: The logarithmic Gromov-Witten generating series of the stated elliptic fibration is, after normalization, a component of a higher-depth vector-valued mock modular form.
notes: The paper explicitly states this general mock-modularity conjecture (lines 180–184) but only proves a special case (mirror to P^2). The full general statement remains unresolved here.

atomic_statement_summary: The matching moment-generating function F_(k,m,n) has no zero in the open disk of radius mn/k.
notes: The zero-free disk property for F_{k,m,n}(t) is stated as a conjecture in the paper, supported by numerical evidence but not proven here.

atomic_statement_summary: Every composition's principal subword downset is rank-unimodal, and hence so is every layered permutation's principal downset.
notes: Stated explicitly as a conjecture; the author notes the general case remains open and only verifies cases up to length 34.

atomic_statement_summary: For every k at least four, the optimal balanced discrepancy is the same universal constant, approximately 0.4407.
notes: The paper proves the constant equals 0.4407 for k∈{4,...,10} but explicitly conjectures the value is universal for all k≥4; the general statement is left open.

atomic_statement_summary: The arithmetic support of the discrete automorphic O-piece is contained in the motivic Langlands-parameter locus.
notes: Posed in the paper as a conjecture that the discrete support lies in the motivic locus; not proved here and presented as a consequence of earlier conjectures.

atomic_statement_summary: The limiting p-Sylow rank distribution of the random bipartite-graph sandpile group is the stated law, with separate odd-prime and p=2 formulas.
notes: This rank-distribution conjecture is presented as a consequence of Conjecture p-Syl_conj and supported by numerical experiments, but not proved in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: For every r at least two, infinite-type interval translation maps form a measure-zero subset of ITM(r).
notes: The same Boshernitzan–Kornfeld conjecture is restated in this paper and remains open beyond special cases; the authors prove topological density but not the measure-zero statement.

atomic_statement_summary: Assuming the stated local conjectures, global localization sends loc_(Z,!) to the restricted dualizing module under the tensor product equivalence.
notes: Conjecture F is posed in the paper; authors verify it only when G is commutative, so the full general statement remains unresolved.
The excerpt is explicitly phrased as the question whether a universal zonotope sparsification constant exists, not as a truth-apt proposition.

atomic_statement_summary: The stated small-normal-curvature immersion condition forces the induced metric to be conformal to one whose four Ricci eigenvalues satisfy the strict three-versus-one inequality.
notes: The imo-ric conjecture is explicitly proposed and not proved; the authors pose it as an open problem and ask whether S^2×T^2 admits such a metric.

atomic_statement_summary: Every positive quasimodular form has a positive-coefficient support of natural density at least one-half.
notes: The paper explicitly poses this as Conjecture 3.6 (lines 1605–1608) and gives examples but does not prove the density exists or is ≥1/2 in general.

atomic_statement_summary: Every intersecting k-uniform family with n greater than 10k has at most the stated number of distinct symmetric differences.
notes: The paper proves the conjectured bound only for n >= 60 k^{3/2} and k >= 50, not for the full stated range n>10k, so the exact original conjecture remains unresolved.

atomic_statement_summary: Assuming local finiteness, the support of the cuspidal O-piece is contained in the finite set of Langlands parameters arising from elliptic Arthur parameters with the prescribed SL_2 orbit.
notes: Extract exactly part (b), the finite elliptic-Arthur support containment. Part (a) merely says that two separately referenced conjectures hold and is not independently releasable.

atomic_statement_summary: A connected locally finite quasi-transitive graph is almost planar exactly when it is quasi-isometric to a planar graph.
notes: The paper proves the k‑planar conjecture for coarsely simply connected graphs (including finitely presented groups) but does not resolve the full conjecture for all connected, locally finite, quasi‑transitive graphs.

atomic_statement_summary: The universal support-forest combinations together with the Laplacian spectrum determine all embedded forest counts, and therefore distinguish trees.
notes: The subtree separation form is presented as a stronger conjecture variant and is not proven; the paper suggests a program for its verification but offers no proof.

atomic_statement_summary: Every automorphism of the power semigroup of a cancellative monoid preserves the singleton-generated subsemigroup.
notes: Conjecture B is presented as an open key step for general cancellative monoids; the paper does not prove it and treats it as future work.

atomic_statement_summary: Every positive weighted Bernoulli(p) sum with p at most one-third exceeds its mean with probability at least p.
notes: The weighted Bernoulli probability conjecture is posed and the paper proves it only for very small p (via MMS-related results); the full p≤1/3 claim remains unresolved.

atomic_statement_summary: For every bipartite infection graph H, the maximum bootstrap-percolation time is little-o of ex(n,H).
notes: The paper states this as Conjecture \ref{conj:bip upper} without proof, discussing it as a belief and not a theorem.

atomic_statement_summary: For fixed m greater than one, the number of symmetric chain decompositions of L(m,n) grows faster than k^n for every fixed k.
notes: Conjecture about super-exponential growth of #SCD(L(m,n)) is stated as a data-supported conjecture; no proof is given in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: Adjacent partition triples admit hook correspondences that carry the two Jack Littlewood-Richardson expressions to each other modulo the common hook.
notes: Adjacency conjecture (hook correspondences inducing equivalence modulo hooks) is presented as a conjecture to appear elsewhere; not proved in this paper.

atomic_statement_summary: Every link has a symmetric quiver whose quiver generating series equals its transformed colored HOMFLY-PT series under the stated change of variables.
notes: The statement is the general Links-Quivers Correspondence for arbitrary links. The paper and cited SW21 only prove the rational-link case; the full conjecture remains unresolved.

atomic_statement_summary: Every A_infinity weight satisfies the stated endpoint weighted Sobolev inequality.
notes: Authors state Conjecture A_infty (A_infty subset W_1) and outline what would suffice to prove it; they do not resolve it.

atomic_statement_summary: Every Eulerian graph is k-flow-connected for k at least four and A-flow-connected for every abelian group A of order at least four.
notes: Authors formulate this Eulerian flow-connectedness conjecture and prove even/large-|A| cases, but the full conjecture (odd cases, all |A|>=4) remains unproved.

atomic_statement_summary: An m-banded Toeplitz symbol has a Jordan curve parametrized by its complex band structure exactly when the limiting finite-section spectrum is real.
notes: The equivalence is posed as a conjecture; authors note the implication (1)->(2) was previously claimed with an erroneous proof, and only (2)->(1) currently holds. The full equivalence is unresolved.

atomic_statement_summary: A cycle avalanche complex whose binary zero set is one residue class modulo k is homotopy equivalent to S^(k-2).
notes: The statement is explicitly posed as a conjecture in the paper and only computationally verified for n<29; authors do not prove it here.

atomic_statement_summary: The sharp Lp exponent in the stated bilinear Heisenberg Kakeya inequality is 2/3.
notes: The paper proves a lower bound p≥2/3 and discusses evidence, but it does not prove the conjectured sharp exponent equals 2/3, leaving it open.

atomic_statement_summary: Among the stated periodic lattice quotients with n^d vertex orbits, the standard product torus uniquely maximizes the spanning-tree count.
notes: The periodic-product-extremal conjecture is presented as a natural periodic analogue and left open in the discussion; no proof given.

atomic_statement_summary: There are finitely many clonoids between two finite modules exactly when the module orders are coprime.
notes: The authors pose the finiteness iff coprime-orders conjecture for all finite modules; they prove many cases (vector spaces, others) but do not establish the full iff statement for all finite modules.

atomic_statement_summary: Every pole of the topological zeta function gives the stated monodromy eigenvalue, and is a root of the Bernstein-Sato polynomial in the strong version.
notes: The Topological Monodromy Conjecture is stated in general; this paper proves it for hyperplane arrangements only, not the full general conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: A five-component intrinsic raw rank exists whose discretization is a bounded-delay ranking function in dimension four and characteristic three, with the explicit ranker extending to higher mixed-term families.
notes: The paper explicitly poses this discretized ranking-function conjecture and states it is supported only by finite computational evidence; it is not proved or refuted in the text.

atomic_statement_summary: If a matchable graph is split into two non-Pfaffian conformal subgraphs, its Pfaffian number strictly exceeds the sum of theirs minus one.
notes: The paper states this inequality as an explicit conjecture in Conclusions and does not prove it; no evidence here that it has been resolved elsewhere.

atomic_statement_summary: For every semisimple mod-p Galois representation, the three crystalline, explicit, and intrinsic Serre-weight sets coincide.
notes: Same optimistic conjecture restated; the paper proves W^{cris}(hobar) subseteq W^{explicit}(hobar) but not the full equality, so the exact statement remains open.
The claim uses the undefined predicate sufficiently capable and an open-ended collection of primitive expert classes, so the asserted limiting probability is not a determinate truth-apt proposition.

atomic_statement_summary: The successive differences of average stack-sorting depth form a monotonically increasing sequence.
notes: Stated explicitly as a future-direction conjecture in the paper; numerical evidence offered but no proof provided in this work.

atomic_statement_summary: If the coincidence constant C_(E,j) vanishes for a non-CM elliptic curve, then one prime p satisfies Q(E[j])=Q(E[pj]).
notes: The conjecture about coincidences of division fields is presented as numerically motivated and explicitly conjectured; the paper proves one direction but not the full converse.

atomic_statement_summary: For every d at least four, the top correction B_d^(d-2)(n) is linear with leading coefficient minus four times the Baxter number Bax(d-3).
notes: The Baxter-onset formula is conjectured, verified numerically through d=11, and the authors explicitly say a proof is open.

atomic_statement_summary: Every principal downset in the permutation-pattern poset is rank-unimodal.
notes: The principal-downset rank-unimodality conjecture is posed explicitly as an open problem in the paper; authors note it is unresolved in the permutation-pattern literature.

atomic_statement_summary: Every K4-free cubic graph has 2-tone edge chromatic number at most eight.
notes: The stronger conjecture τ'_2(G) ≤ 8 for K4-free cubic graphs is proposed and only validated for certain classes; the general conjecture is not proved here.

atomic_statement_summary: An expanding integer toral endomorphism has a linear Markov partition exactly when some matrix power is diagonalizable with integer eigenvalues.
notes: The iff statement is conjectured for general n; the paper proves one direction in general and the full equivalence only for d=2, leaving the general case open.

atomic_statement_summary: Every bounded-treewidth graph class is rainbow separable.
notes: Authors pose this conjecture in Future Work; paper does not prove that all bounded-treewidth classes are rainbow separable.

atomic_statement_summary: The Hartshorne-Rao module of a union of general lines in projective three-space has the strong Lefschetz property.
notes: Placed in the Open Questions section; authors proved SLP in range ≤3 but conjecture full SLP for unions of general lines and do not prove it.

atomic_statement_summary: Smooth translation-invariant valuations satisfy the mixed hard Lefschetz theorem and mixed Hodge-Riemann relations for the specified convex-body data.
notes: Alesker formulates the mixed hard Lefschetz and mixed Hodge–Riemann conjectures for Val^∞(V); the paper proves only non-mixed degree-1 cases, so the general conjecture remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: The maximal complete-pivoting growth factor for real 5-by-5 matrices is the unique root in [4,5] of the stated degree-61 polynomial.
notes: Authors present an exact algebraic candidate (root of a degree-61 polynomial) and state it as a conjecture that this lower bound is the global maximum; they do not prove it is the absolute maximum over all combinatorial cases.

atomic_statement_summary: If the stated divisor-sum congruence holds throughout an arithmetic progression An+B, then A is 0 modulo 4 and B is 2 modulo 4.
notes: Presented as a conjecture in concluding remarks about necessary form of arithmetic progressions; the paper does not prove it.

atomic_statement_summary: The complexity of finite smooth binary words grows as Theta(n^rho) with the stated exponent rho.
notes: The growth-rate conjecture p_{C_f^infty}(n)=Θ(n^ρ) is the main conjecture; the paper proves it for even alphabets and partial bounds elsewhere, leaving the full statement unresolved.

The proposed sharp phase transition is expressed using undefined approximation relations and gives mutually inconsistent threshold scales in its statement and sketch, so it is not a determinate release proposition.

atomic_statement_summary: There are exactly 105 distribution-equivalence classes of mesh patterns of length two.
notes: Authors prove number of classes lies between 105 and 108 and explicitly conjecture the exact value 105; not proved in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: The Hasse-Witt invariant is the degree-(p-1) period truncation up to sign, and its normalized mirror-map expression is p-integral and congruent to one modulo p.
notes: Authors pose this Hasse–Witt vs period congruence as a conjecture and only provide numerical/experimental evidence; they explicitly note related p-integrality is an unsolved conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: The variance of left prime truncations has the stated leading constant times log-squared ell, with an O_b(log ell) error.
notes: The paper states Conjecture \ref{conj:varnf} with only heuristic evidence and explicitly calls it difficult to prove; no proof or refutation is given in the text.

atomic_statement_summary: The self-extension algebra of the tensor unit in the stated category is the Q-invariant coordinate algebra of the Slodowy slice.
notes: Conjecture \ref{Slod} is posed in general; the paper verifies it in a particular G2 subregular example but does not prove the general isomorphism.

atomic_statement_summary: For each of the two specified rank-2-attractor parameters, the four-dimensional etale representation is the restricted direct sum of the stated weight-four and twisted weight-two modular representations.
notes: Conjecture 2 (phi_{±}=33±8√17) is stated but the paper focuses on proving Conjecture 1 for phi = -1/7; Conjecture 2 is not proved here and remains open as stated.

atomic_statement_summary: Every Ferrers diagram, distance, and finite field admit a maximum-dimension Ferrers-diagram rank-metric code.
notes: Paper states the Etzion-Silberstein conjecture is widely open and only partial cases are known; the authors reduce it to irreducible diagrams but do not prove it in full.

atomic_statement_summary: One-box pivots give the stated congruence between normalized shifted Macdonald Littlewood-Richardson coefficients modulo the common hook.
notes: The Macdonald pivot congruences are presented as a conjecture and the paper states a proof would follow contingent on two unproven properties; they do not prove it here.

atomic_statement_summary: Every connected n-vertex graph has burning number at most ceiling(sqrt(n)).
notes: The Burning Number Conjecture b(G) ≤ ⌈√n⌉ is stated as a central open problem; the paper notes only asymptotic progress, not a full proof of the exact inequality.

atomic_statement_summary: Every polarized maximal Calabi-Yau degeneration admits special Lagrangian torus fibrations on subsets whose normalized Calabi-Yau measure tends to one.
notes: The Metric SYZ conjecture is presented as the classical open conjecture; the paper addresses it under additional assumptions, but the full conjecture remains open.
The excerpt only asserts that an unspecified classification in Theorem maintheorem is exhaustive; it does not include the characterization needed for a standalone conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: The stated expression bounds the total number of cliques in every K_(ell+1)-free r-graph, with the specified multipartite hypergraph as the unique divisible extremizer.
notes: The paper proves the clique-counting conjecture only in the specific case (r,ℓ)=(3,4); the general Conjecture 14 (FGT22) remains unproven here.

atomic_statement_summary: The l-adic Galois action on the cohomology of a smooth projective variety is semisimple.
notes: The semisimplicity conjecture for ℓ-adic Galois action is stated as an open expectation; the paper notes implications but does not prove it.

atomic_statement_summary: Every connected graph of maximum degree at most four satisfies mu-star(G) at most H(G).
notes: The paper explicitly poses the statement as a conjecture and does not prove or refute it; only exhaustive search up to 11 vertices found no counterexample, so it remains open here.

atomic_statement_summary: Imposing equivariance under the full group cannot increase the minimum fiber dimension relative to a data subgroup.
notes: The paper explicitly lists this as the remaining main conjecture and does not prove it; it is posed as an open problem (nontrivial for continuous boundaries).

atomic_statement_summary: No closed symplectically aspherical manifold admits a positive-scalar-curvature metric.
notes: Authors state the DDJ conjecture and prove it only in the spin finite-cover case (Theorem), so the exact general statement remains unresolved.

atomic_statement_summary: For all g and n, every even cohomology group H^k of the stable moduli space with k at most 20 is tautological.
notes: The taut 20 conjecture is cited from CLP24 as a proposed extension and remains conjectural in the paper; not proven here.

atomic_statement_summary: A symmetric monoidal functor TW exists from fermionic groups to spaces over BO/BSpin and satisfies the stated objectwise and Thom-spectrum compatibility conditions.
notes: The existence of the symmetric monoidal functor TW is explicitly posed as a conjecture after a partial result; the paper does not remove the hypothesis, so the statement remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: For every Polish group, nonmeager independence is the maximum strongly admissible geometry.
notes: Author conjectures ind^{nm} is the maximum for Polish groups; the paper proves this under the extra σ-compact hypothesis only, so the general Polish-group case remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: Characteristic-p models of every complex KLT log Fano pair have uniform positive lower bounds for both F-signature and the FA invariant on a dense open base.
notes: The paper states the conjecture and proves only special cases (3D non-weakly-exceptional singularities and low-degree hypersurfaces), not the full uniform lower-bound statement, so the exact conjecture remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: For sparse Erdos-Renyi graphs and fixed power r, the chromatic number of the graph power is of the same order as the larger of its clique number and n over its independence number.
notes: The authors state this asymptotic equality for the chromatic number of G_{n,p}^r as a conjecture; the paper establishes bounds but does not prove the exact Theta equality conjectured.

atomic_statement_summary: The Cartesian product of any two odd cycles has list chromatic number three.
notes: Li et al.'s conjecture χ_ℓ(C_{2m+1}□C_{2n+1})=3 is presented and the paper notes the list chromatic number remains unknown, so the exact conjecture is open.

atomic_statement_summary: The discrete automorphic L2 space splits over motivic Langlands parameters as stated, and under the stronger local-finiteness hypothesis every summand is at most one-dimensional.
notes: Posed as a conjectural splitting of L^2_discr indexed by motivic parameters and one-dimensionality statements; presented without proof and conditional on other conjectures.

atomic_statement_summary: Corrected codimension-g special cycles on a toroidal compactification have a Chow-valued generating series that is a Siegel modular form of weight (n+2)/2.
notes: Paper explicitly states the Kudla toroidal compactification conjecture remains open in general, with only divisor and zero-cycle cases recently solved.

atomic_statement_summary: The proportion of n-element matroids that are paving tends to one.
notes: The classic MNW conjecture that almost all matroids are paving is cited and explicitly stated; the authors note their results do not resolve it.

atomic_statement_summary: Every additive smoothing function on cusped curves is represented uniquely by intersection with an open geodesic current.
notes: The paper states this as an open conjecture for open surfaces and provides motivating examples without proving it.

atomic_statement_summary: The Unpin_AVOID problem is PSPACE-complete in every stated case, including its simple variant for at least four strands.
notes: Authors state PSPACE-completeness as a conjecture for Unpin_AVOID variants; no proof is given in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: The limiting scale satisfies sigma-bar asymptotic to lambda times u^(alpha/H) eta^(1-alpha/H) tau^((alpha-1)/H), with H as specified.
notes: Extract exactly the scaling-parameter asymptotic. The same source block repeats the multi-regime limiting-process claim, including the separately proved J2 limit, while the coefficient law remains conjectural.

atomic_statement_summary: The effective movable cone of a Calabi-Yau variety has a finite rational polyhedral fundamental domain under birational automorphisms.
notes: The Morrison–Kawamata movable cone conjecture is a broad open conjecture; the paper discusses known verifications in special families but does not prove the general statement.

atomic_statement_summary: Infinitely many n satisfy tau(n+k) much less than k uniformly for every positive k.
notes: The author obtains only a weaker divisor bound (τ(n+k) ≪ k^C) as a corollary; the original Erdős conjecture τ(n+k) ≪ k remains unproven here.

atomic_statement_summary: Every graph in the union of the stated even-hole classes is 3-colorable.
notes: The paper proves the ℓ=4 case and cites Chen's result for ℓ≥5, but the full conjecture for all ℓ≥2 (notably small ℓ like 2,3) remains unproven.

atomic_statement_summary: Among connected n-vertex graphs, the path minimizes positive p-energy for every integer p at least two.
notes: The paper states the positive p-energy conjecture (p≥2) but does not prove it; only partial bounds (e.g. E^+_3(G) ≥ (√5/2)n) are given.

atomic_statement_summary: Each color threshold of the random Borsuk graph occurs at a distinct constant multiple of n^(-1/d), with the stated zero-one law.
notes: Authors state Conjecture 3.3 about constants c_k and thresholds for 3<=k<=d; no proof given in paper.

atomic_statement_summary: Every n bounded complex vectors admit a unimodular vector whose inner products with all of them have modulus at most sqrt(n).
notes: Conjecture 1 asserts existence of a unimodular vector with |⟨x,a_i⟩| ≤ √n for all n; paper proves only n=2,3, so the general statement remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: The polynomial volume growth of a zero-entropy automorphism never lies strictly between (d-1)^2+1 and d^2.
notes: The Second Gap Principle is explicitly proposed as a conjecture; the paper proves it in some ranges (d≤7) but does not establish the full conjecture for all d.

atomic_statement_summary: Every K3-divisible n-vertex graph of minimum degree at least 3n/4 has a perfect triangle packing.
notes: This is the classical Nash–Williams conjecture stated in the introduction; it remains unresolved (only asymptotic/partial results known).

atomic_statement_summary: For every surface, SimplePin with four strands is NP-complete.
notes: The paper explicitly poses this as an open conjecture and does not prove it (it proves P for s≤3 and NP-hardness for s≥20, but not NP-completeness for s=4).

atomic_statement_summary: If the first dynamical degree grows like n^k, then polynomial volume growth is at least d+k(k+2)/4.
notes: The Lower Bound is posed as a conjecture; the paper proves it for the special case k=2d−2 but explicitly states it remains open in other parameter ranges.

atomic_statement_summary: As opposite labels coalesce in the stated topological Yang-Mills-Higgs problem, matter energy diverges under full back-reaction and curvature obeys the stated dimension-dependent four- and two-dimensional asymptotics.
notes: Tier-2 proximity scaling is presented as a conjecture; parts are proved in special settings (n=4, n=2), but full conjecture (persistence under full back-reaction etc.) remains conjectural.

atomic_statement_summary: The totally nonnegative part of the twisted double flag variety equals its intersection with the nonnegative canonical-basis projective cone.
notes: The paper formulates the equality as a conjecture and only proves one inclusion; the full equality remains unproven in this work.

atomic_statement_summary: The stated smoothed twisted average of Salie sums satisfies a uniform epsilon-power bound.
notes: The paper explicitly conditions its improvement on this Twisted Linnik–Selberg-type conjecture and does not prove it; it remains an external open hypothesis.

atomic_statement_summary: For every n at least two, the pure Morse-matching complexes of the n-simplex and its boundary are homotopy equivalent.
notes: Paper verifies the statement for n=2 and n=3 but explicitly states the conjecture is open for n >= 4; the paper does not prove the general case.

atomic_statement_summary: If a permutation contains the pattern 45312, then its Kazhdan-Lusztig basis element has no reversal factorization.
notes: The paper presents this pattern-avoidance conjecture on reversal factorizations as an open conjecture, offering evidence and small-n verification but not a proof.

atomic_statement_summary: The localization functor has the stated mapping-object right adjoint.
notes: The paper explicitly states this as a conjecture and does not prove it; authors describe what would be required to prove it, so the exact statement remains open here.

atomic_statement_summary: The H-free edge-subdivision problem has the stated NP-complete classification, and under ETH admits no 2^o(k) polynomial-time algorithm in those cases.
notes: Authors state the complexity classification as a conjecture, verify it for many H but do not prove the full classification; thus the exact conjecture remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: The map alpha_T has the stated maximal rank for a general tensor.
notes: Conjecture 1 about maximal rank of α_T is posed in the Conjectures section and not proved in the paper; subsequent conjectures are conditional on it.

atomic_statement_summary: The SL(2,Z)-orbit graphs of primitive square-tiled surfaces in H(2) form an expander family.
notes: McMullen's conjecture is stated and only supported by indirect evidence in this paper; the authors prove Euler characteristic growth but do not prove expansion.

atomic_statement_summary: The characteristic ideal of the dual p-primary Selmer group over the cyclotomic extension equals the ideal generated by the p-adic L-function.
notes: The Mazur–Swinnerton-Dyer Iwasawa main conjecture for elliptic curves is stated; the paper notes it is known in many cases but not proven in full generality.

atomic_statement_summary: The number of symmetric chain decompositions of M(n) grows faster than k^n for every fixed k.
notes: Conjecture on growth of #SCD(M(n)) is posed and supported by computations; the paper does not prove it.

atomic_statement_summary: The coarse-homotopy-to-shape functor F is faithful.
notes: Thesis explicitly states faithfulness of the functor F as a conjecture and only outlines an attempt, not a proof.

atomic_statement_summary: The Higgs Fourier transform admits the stated quantization, which for sufficiently large degree realizes de Rham geometric Langlands.
notes: The paper states this as an expectation/conjecture and does not prove the quantization or de Rham geometric Langlands realization; remains an open target in the text.

atomic_statement_summary: For every fixed k at least six, the maximum number of k-holes is O_k(n^ceiling(k/3)).
notes: The authors conjecture the sharper upper bound h_k(n)=O_k(n^{⌈k/3⌉}); their main theorem gives only weaker matching lower and upper bounds, so the conjecture remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: The stated Fourier-integral transform of the high-density half-space log-gamma distribution equals the comparison distribution.
notes: This is a separate but analogous conjecture (for the \tbeta>\ttt case) stated by the authors; it is presented as an expectation and not established in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: The stated connection-side window category is equivalent to the compact micro-support category on the semistable Higgs side.
notes: The authors explicitly state this categorical equivalence as an expectation/conjecture and do not prove it in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: Applying the stacking operation to a losing partition in the stated circumstances produces a P-position.
notes: Stacking conjecture (Conjecture~\ref{conj:bloby}) is posed without proof; authors state it and derive consequences assuming it, so it remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: Every two-dimensional configuration of low convex pattern complexity is periodic.
notes: The convex-shape variant of Nivat is presented as an analogue and the paper explicitly notes this analogue is also open.

atomic_statement_summary: The class of every two-row Springer-fiber component is obtained by the stated nested-cup divided-difference product applied to the longest Schubert polynomial.
notes: Authors pose the divided-difference formula as a conjecture, confirm cases and prove special families but do not prove the general statement.

atomic_statement_summary: An isolated characteristic-zero graded singularity with negative b-invariant is of strongly F-regular type, and is log terminal when Q-Gorenstein.
notes: Authors pose Conjecture 2.3 asserting b(R)<0 implies strongly F-regular type (and log-terminal if Q-Gorenstein); they prove special cases (dim 2, F-pure) but not the general statement.

atomic_statement_summary: Every link has a symmetric quiver whose quiver generating series equals its transformed colored HOMFLY-PT series under a change of variables.
notes: Semantic duplicate of id 17, which states the same general links-quivers correspondence more explicitly and is kept as the representative.

atomic_statement_summary: The probability of the centered subset sum being nonnegative satisfies the stated hypergeometric lower bound for every admissible n, k, and weight vector.
notes: The Aydinian–Blinovsky refinement is presented as an open conjecture; the paper discusses partial progress but does not resolve it completely.

atomic_statement_summary: The graphical Stirling-number sequence of every planar graph is unimodal.
notes: The unimodality for arbitrary planar graphs is posed as an open conjecture in the paper's 'Further Work and Open Problems' and is not proved here.

atomic_statement_summary: In each of the remaining 33 complementary polynomial pairs, at least one polynomial has a negative coefficient.
notes: The paper explicitly states this as a conjecture after extensive testing and does not provide a proof or counterexample; it is posed as an open problem for future work.

atomic_statement_summary: For all g and n, every cohomology group H^k of the stable moduli space with k at most 10 is tautological.
notes: The taut 10 conjecture is presented as a conjectured corollary/variant and is not proved in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: The higher-torsion classes associated with two nullhomotopies differ by the specified Pontryagin class.
notes: The cohomological identity is posed as a conjecture in the Floer-theoretic discussion and is not proved in this paper.

atomic_statement_summary: The p-Stam inequality holds for every degree at least three, every p in (1,2], and all monic real-rooted polynomial pairs.
notes: The p-Stam validity for p\le2 is posed explicitly as a conjecture; the paper provides numerical and conditional evidence but does not prove it for all n and p in (1,2].

atomic_statement_summary: Every weighted graph excluding a fixed d-fat minor has a balanced separator coverable by O(sqrt(n)) bounded-radius balls.
notes: The paper proves a coarse separator with c n^{1/2+ε} balls for every ε>0, and explicitly states the stronger c√n (no ε) version as a conjecture; it is not proved here.

atomic_statement_summary: On every chaotic compact manifold, a density-one subsequence of Laplace eigenfunctions is sign-balanced above the stated logarithmic wavelength scale.
notes: This deterministic sign-balance statement is posed as a conjecture; the paper proves analogous random results but does not resolve the deterministic conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: The critical four-dimensional PES mass is 64 pi^2 tau over chi, with boundedness, loss of compactness, and unboundedness on the three sides of the threshold.
notes: The sharp threshold M_* is presented as a conjecture contingent on a sharp K_tau-adapted logarithmic HLS/Adams inequality; no proof is given in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: For each fixed reticulation number k at least two, the ratio of orchard to reticulation-visible network counts converges to a constant greater than one.
notes: The paper reports numerical evidence and formulates the asymptotic ratio conjecture; it is not proven within the work.

atomic_statement_summary: There exists an MRD code of the stated rectangular parameters whose one-row puncturing embeds in an MRD code of the stated square parameters.
notes: Paper introduces this puncturing-inclusion MRD conjecture as an open problem and proves only equivalence to certain MFD existence; it is presented and left open.

atomic_statement_summary: Under the stated Haag-Kastler, nontriviality, and CCR assumptions, the kinematic group is non-Galilean and has metric spacelike separation with a finite invariant signaling speed.
notes: The SR-selection is presented as the paper's central structural conjecture; supporting arguments and related theorems appear in the series, but the conjecture itself is not proved here.

atomic_statement_summary: For every graph, the sum of its k largest Laplacian eigenvalues is at most its edge count plus binomial(k+1,2).
notes: Brouwer's conjecture on Laplacian eigenvalue sums is stated as a well-known open problem; paper notes verified cases but remains open in general.

atomic_statement_summary: Every K5-minor-free graph with a correspondence 6-cover has six disjoint correspondence colorings.
notes: The conjecture is posed as an open problem; the paper proves related weaker/partial results (upper bound 8, constructions for 3 colorings) but not the asserted equality chisc(K5)=6.

atomic_statement_summary: Generalized k-Markov numbers indexed by reduced rationals are pairwise distinct for every k.
notes: The paper states this as a new conjecture in the concluding discussion and does not prove or disprove it; it is proposed as future work (a strengthening of prior conjecture).

atomic_statement_summary: Every graph of maximum degree four has both median eigenvalues at least minus sqrt(3).
notes: The authors note Mohar's conjecture remains unsettled for d=4 and explicitly pose the d=4 median-eigenvalue bound as a conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: The two discrete line ensembles converge uniformly on compact sets to the Airy line ensemble.
notes: The paper explicitly states this as a conjecture (uniform-on-compact convergence) and only proves weaker/partial convergence results; the exact uniform convergence is not proved here.

atomic_statement_summary: The map from A to holomorphic-topological sl_2 observables is an isomorphism of Poisson vertex algebras.
notes: The author conjectures the map φ is an isomorphism of Poisson vertex algebras, performs checks but explicitly leaves the isomorphism to future work.

atomic_statement_summary: The naive atomic decomposition of a blowup is obtained by sorting the decomposition of the base with c-1 copies of that of the center.
notes: A more precise naive Iritani conjecture is posed and only illustrated by examples; the paper does not prove the general statement.

atomic_statement_summary: Every properly edge-colored Dirac graph has a Hamilton cycle using at least n/2-o(n) distinct colors.
notes: The paper cites the conjecture (lines 211–213) and proves a near-case for c>1/2 (lines 216–223), but the exact δ(G)≥n/2 (c=1/2) case remains unresolved.

atomic_statement_summary: Every nonidentity permutation pattern is inversion monotone.
notes: The inversion-monotonicity conjecture (all nontrivial patterns are inversion monotone) is stated as open; the paper proves only special cases.

atomic_statement_summary: Every admissible pair of Schoenberg parameter sequences is realized as the Toeplitz limit of positive partial-flag points.
notes: Conjecture~\ref{c:pflagconjectures-alt} is formulated in full generality and left unproven; the paper only gives partial results/propositions elsewhere.

atomic_statement_summary: The stated divisibility-or-size condition is sufficient for the q-integer product to be unimodal, and is also necessary when k or the power is small.
notes: Authors present this as a conjecture, verify computationally for small ranges, and do not prove the full general statement.

atomic_statement_summary: A harmonic map of the disk with Schwarzian norm at most 3/2 extends homeomorphically to the closed target domain.
notes: Authors state the homeomorphic-extension-at-3/2 threshold as a stronger conjecture; paper does not prove it, only gives weaker existence results.

atomic_statement_summary: Exactly the densities below 4/9 are jumps for 3-uniform hypergraphs, while every density from 4/9 to one is a non-jump.
notes: Paper proves 4/9 is a non-jump but explicitly poses the global statement about all numbers below/above 4/9 as an open conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: The critical-radius function has a unique stationary point above one and is decreasing before it and increasing after it.
notes: The paper proves existence of at least one parameter-critical a^sharp but conjectures uniqueness; it remains unresolved in the text.

atomic_statement_summary: Assuming RH and simple zeta zeros, the stated negative second-moment sum is asymptotic to T/(2 pi).
notes: Ng's companion conjecture for the zeta-function is cited as an open conjecture; the paper references it and does not prove it.

atomic_statement_summary: All graphs are well-quasi-ordered by the pivot-minor relation.
notes: Oum's pivot-minor well-quasi-ordering is stated as an open conjecture; the paper notes the bipartite case is resolved but does not settle the general conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: No stationary online inference-caching algorithm has worst-case acquisition cost little-o of 2^H log N expert creations.
notes: LAWS convergence rate lower bound is posed as a conjecture invoking coupon-collector intuition; paper states a sketch but not a formal proof, leaving it open.

atomic_statement_summary: For nonregular initial data in dimension at least three, the restricted holonomy group of Laplacian dynamics is SO(d).
notes: Explicitly labeled a conjecture in the paper; authors provide conditional results and heuristics but leave the full generic statement open.

atomic_statement_summary: Every sufficiently large 2-modular witness contains a 4-modular witness of exactly the prescribed size.
notes: Finite first-bit obstruction elimination is presented as a conjecture and not proved in the paper; authors separate it as a conservative open version.

atomic_statement_summary: The locally analytic torus action on the Igusa coordinate algebra extends to the overconvergent nearly holomorphic module.
notes: Presented as a conjectural generalization; authors explicitly say it is not clear whether their proof generalizes and do not prove it.

atomic_statement_summary: Reductions of every complex KLT singularity have F-signature bounded uniformly away from zero for all sufficiently large primes.
notes: The liminf positivity conjecture for F-signature (Carvajal-Rojas–Schwede–Tucker) is stated and while many cases are proved in the paper, the general conjecture is not fully resolved.

atomic_statement_summary: The width omega(A) of every full-spark (2M-1)-by-M real matrix decays exponentially in M relative to its largest row norm.
notes: Paper states this Balan–Wang style conjecture as an open problem; no proof or refutation is given and it remains unresolved in literature.

atomic_statement_summary: The four stated quantum-toroidal operators have the conjectured Pieri differential-operator formulas and coefficient generating functions.
notes: The Pieri-type equalities are presented explicitly as a conjecture which the authors assume and base computations on; no proof of the conjectured operator identities is given.

atomic_statement_summary: For every r at least three, the prefix value a_r(r) equals Golomb's value G(r-1).
notes: The paper explicitly presents this as a conjecture and reports only computational verification up to r≤200; no proof or disproof appears in the text.

atomic_statement_summary: The multiplicative group of a noncommutative division ring has no nilpotent maximal subgroup.
notes: The paper proves the conjecture for cyclic division algebras (special case) but does not resolve the general statement for all noncommutative division rings.

atomic_statement_summary: The rainbow perfect-matching Maker-Breaker bias threshold is asymptotic to n^2 divided by 2 log n.
notes: The conjectured threshold for the rainbow perfect matching game is stated at the end as an open problem; no proof is given.

atomic_statement_summary: The spectral-order comparison constant c_vee(d) can be chosen equal to one in every dimension.
notes: The paper explicitly poses this as a conjecture in the Comments section and only observes the commuting-positive case; no proof or counterexample is provided in the surrounding text.

atomic_statement_summary: For every binary path configuration, avalanche homology has no Betti numbers above floor(n/2)-1.
notes: The Betti-vanishing bound for binary initial configurations is conjectured; authors verified it computationally for n<20 but did not prove it in general.

atomic_statement_summary: The cumulant-based quantum relative functional is nonnegative and monotone under every support-compatible completely positive channel after regularization.
notes: The authors formulate this QDPI under CoP channels as a conjecture, provide numerical evidence, and explicitly state it has not been established analytically.

atomic_statement_summary: Every entire critical abelian Yang-Mills-Higgs field with density 2 pi and the stated boundary behavior is a gauge-translated pullback of the degree-one planar solution.
notes: Gibbon's conjecture is presented as an open rigidity problem; only partial results (low dimensions or minimisers) are known and cited, not a full proof.

atomic_statement_summary: All coefficients in the stated equivariant quantum-cohomology triple product are polynomials with nonnegative coefficients in y_i-z_j.
notes: Authors pose refined Graham positivity for the triple product as an explicit conjecture and do not claim a full proof in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: For every complex KLT log Fano pair, both the lower F-signature and lower alpha invariant are positive.
notes: The positivity of lim-inf invariants s_- and α_- for KLT log Fano pairs is posed as a conjecture; the paper discusses and proves cases but does not resolve it universally.
